components.css: .ds-today-hero { background: #FDFCFA; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E0D8; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-today-main { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-today-num { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; color: #2C2824; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-today-week { font-size: 15px; color: #6B6560; } .ds-today-sub { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: #6B6560; } .ds-pill { display: inline-block; margin-top: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #F3E4E4; color: #D44B4F; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Day Cell Today Ring

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 月历工具栏无边框图标按钮。
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #6B6560; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: #2C2824; } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D44B4F; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: CalendarPlus 是菜单栏里一块安静、信息足的日期玻璃。暖米白底、朱砂红点缀、今日条优先。弹窗是单层表面，不靠卡片套娃。
keyCharacteristics: 顶部今日条承担主叙事
暖中性浅色为默认精致态
今天用描边环而非整块红底

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: 中性色向暖沙偏，禁止冷蓝灰 SaaS 背景。

rules.name: The Semantic Red Rule
rules.body: 红色只表达今天语义、周末、节日、休班。

rules.name: The One Line Detail Rule
rules.body: 每格最多一行副文案，节日优先于农历。

rules.name: The Flat Popover Rule
rules.body: 禁止 card-in-card；深度靠色差与分隔线。

dos: Do 用暖沙 surface 作弹窗根
Do 让今日条 1 秒内回答今天是否放假
Do 休班用淡色整格底
Do 使用 SF Pro 与 macOS 原生控件
donts: Don't 做网页风卡片套壳
Don't 照搬 Windows 11 任务栏日历
Don't 使用霓虹深色、玻璃模糊、渐变字
Don't 用三角角标作为休班主标识
Don't 在格内用整块红底表示今天
